title: Shinonome Ena — The Best Angle For The Perfect Pic〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: The Best Angle For The Perfect Pic（3★）
meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She hasn't been on since we went to PXL... That's what, like a week now...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <She wasn't here much before that since she had to study for that practice exam too. I feel like we've been missing her a lot.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Normally, I'd be suggesting that we throw an afterparty right about now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, right. We haven't had a chance to yet even though our new song's up online.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Exactly. And K's already has a concept in mind for our next song, so now seems like the perfect time to throw one...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I'd rather not force Yuki into coming. Why don't we throw one ourselves and let Yuki know what's going on?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Okay, let's go with that!
I'll let Yuki know.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: As we suspected, Mafuyu can't join us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Especially with cram school and dealing with club activities even on her days off.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But she sent us some lyrics on Nightcord yesterday, so it'd be good to see that she can at least still do that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: As unfortunate as it is that we can't work on our music or throw afterparties together...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This might not be all bad for Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: From what I understand, Mafuyu has to take short naps in order to work from 25:00 onwards...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But she's essentially just resting her eyes and not getting in any real sleep, so she's always seemed somewhat sleep deprived...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, you're saying that she'll have the time to get in some real sleep now...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh?
You're one to talk, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...? But I usually try to get in as much sleep as I think I need...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha... Yeah, your measure of how much sleep you “need” is sort of the issue...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I do hope that Mafuyu gets a chance to rest her body.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You really think she'll use that time to sleep? What if she just ends up studying instead of working on music...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... But her mom probably doesn't want her to stay up late, so she might actually be able to get in some actual sleep.

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience!
Here are your drinks and food.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow! This sizzling Salisbury steak with cheese inside smells so good!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Geez, Mizuki, you always go for the really hearty stuff.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Because I'm still growing♪
Oh, I'll put the fries in the middle so you two can also grab some, Kanade, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's raise our glasses.
Kanade, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Good work on our most recent music video. I'm looking forward to seeing how our next one turns out.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Why don't we tell Mafuyu the same thing by sending her a message?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sure, why not?
She probably knows that we're having our afterparty right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, Kanade, mind raising your glass again and posing like you're about to say, “Cheers”...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, we're sending her pictures?
What if she's studying? Even she might find that a bit irritating, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But wouldn't it be nice to make her feel included and give her a taste of the fun we're having? So, Ena, strike a good pose for me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
A good pose...?
You could at least give me better directions if we're actually doing this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, you said it!
Both of you, get your drinks ready and...
